subject: Game Theory
title: Good Cop, Bad Cop
description: A 60-second lesson on Good Cop, Bad Cop.

hook.text: One negotiator is harsh. The other is friendly. The target gravitates toward the 'nice' one and concedes.

buildup.text: Good cop/bad cop exploits contrast: the bad cop sets a threatening anchor, making the good cop seem reasonable.

discovery.text: It works because humans instinctively reciprocate kindness—even when they know it's a tactic.

twist.text: Savvy negotiators neutralize it by addressing both cops as one team: 'What's your united position?'

climax.text: Car dealerships use this constantly: the salesperson sympathizes while 'the manager' plays hardball.

quiz.question: How does good cop/bad cop work?
